Riverbend Food Bank

Riverbend Food Bank works to end hunger in Riverbend County by distributing healthy food through a network of 85 partner pantries, school programs and mobile markets.

Last year we distributed 4.2 million meals to more than 30,000 neighbours. Our work is supported by the Salesforce Foundation and hundreds of local donors.

Riverbend Food Bank is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit. EIN 12-3456789.
